cohort: 402 African parturients scheduled for elective caesarean delivery
finding: Skin to subarachnoid space depth (SSD) correlated well with weight, and a new formula (4.34 + weight × 0.03) was developed to predict SSD in this cohort of African parturients.
mod_finding: This study focused on predicting skin to subarachnoid space depth in parturients undergoing cesarean delivery and did not involve comparing different modes of delivery.
